# SeaWindow: Tide Times & Charts

> Official website of SeaWindow, an iPhone app for tide times, tide charts and coastal weather, made by independent developer Mohamed Elatabany.

SeaWindow is an iPhone app (iOS 18 or later) that shows tide times and tide charts, hourly coastal weather, waves and swell, sea temperature, and sun and moon times for coasts worldwide. US tides come from NOAA CO-OPS predictions at more than 3,000 stations. Elsewhere SeaWindow uses open international tide-station data, calculated on the iPhone, or WorldTides predictions, and where no station is near, the EOT20 global tide model, labelled as an estimate. Weather comes from Apple Weather. Today's forecast and charts, a tide widget and one favorite coast are free; optional SeaWindow Pro adds ten days ahead, every chart for every day, annual tide tables, unlimited favorites, alerts, offline forecasts, all widgets, Live Activities and Apple Watch. No account, no ads, no tracking. It is a planning aid, not a navigation or safety tool.

App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6811683172

## Pages

- [About SeaWindow and Its Developer](https://atabany.github.io/seawindow-site/about.html): SeaWindow is an iPhone tide app by independent developer Mohamed Elatabany: how it and this site are made, where its data comes from, and how to reach me.
- [Tide Guides: Read Tide Charts and Plan Around the Tide](https://atabany.github.io/seawindow-site/guides.html): Free, sourced tide guides from SeaWindow: read a tide chart, estimate tide height, and plan fishing, surfing, tide pooling and beach walks around the tide.
- [SeaWindow: Tide Times, Tide Charts & Weather for iPhone](https://atabany.github.io/seawindow-site/): Tide times and tide charts for your coast, with wind, waves, sea temperature, sunrise and moon phase. NOAA tides in the US, coasts worldwide. Free on iPhone.
- [SeaWindow Privacy Policy](https://atabany.github.io/seawindow-site/privacy.html): How SeaWindow handles your places, location, journal and purchases: no account, no ads, no tracking. Which forecast services receive a coast's coordinates.
- [SeaWindow Support: Help, Contact and Purchases](https://atabany.github.io/seawindow-site/support.html): Get help with SeaWindow: estimated tides, missing weather or waves, location, alerts, SeaWindow Pro and restoring a purchase. Email the developer.

## Tools

- [Tide height calculator](https://atabany.github.io/seawindow-site/tide-calculator.html): Free tide height calculator: enter a high and low tide to get the water level at any time, or when the tide reaches a height. Rule of twelfths vs cosine.

## Guides

- [How to read a tide chart](https://atabany.github.io/seawindow-site/how-to-read-a-tide-chart.html): Read a tide chart in minutes: time, height, highs and lows, and the datum behind each number, with a worked NOAA example and the steps in SeaWindow.
- [Why tide times differ between apps and websites](https://atabany.github.io/seawindow-site/why-tide-times-differ.html): Two tide sources disagree? It is usually the station, its distance, the datum, the time zone or rounding. A worked NOAA example shows how much each one matters.
- [King tides 2026–2027: what they are and when to expect them](https://atabany.github.io/seawindow-site/king-tides.html): King tides are the year’s highest tides. California’s official 2026–27 dates, why they come in winter, and a NOAA San Francisco example with real numbers.
- [Spring and neap tides explained, with 2026–27 dates](https://atabany.github.io/seawindow-site/spring-and-neap-tides.html): Spring tides come with new and full moons, neap tides with the quarters. Why, how big the gap is at Boston, and phase dates from December 2026 to June 2027.
- [Best tide for tide pooling: how low, when, and how to find minus tides](https://atabany.github.io/seawindow-site/best-tide-for-tide-pooling.html): The best tide for tide pooling is a minus tide in daylight. How low is low enough, when to arrive, and how to find the month’s best lows, with a NOAA example.
- [Best tide for fishing: incoming, outgoing and slack water](https://atabany.github.io/seawindow-site/best-tide-for-fishing.html): Incoming, outgoing or slack: how tides shape saltwater fishing, why slack water is not always at high or low tide, and a worked NOAA example from Charleston.
- [When is high tide? Why it’s about 50 minutes later each day](https://atabany.github.io/seawindow-site/when-is-high-tide.html): High tide comes about 50 minutes later each day because a lunar day lasts 24 hours 50 minutes. See it in a week of NOAA tides, then find today’s high.
